paragraphs: Rabbi Yakim, a man of Hadar.

A Tanna mentioned in Mishnah Eduyot, chapter 7, mishnah 5: Rabbi Yehoshua and Rabbi Yakim of Hadar testified that, if a jar containing red-heifer ashes is placed upon a dead creeping thing, the ashes are impure. Yuchasin reads “of Chadid,” while Seder HaDorot reads “of Tadir.”

notes.text: קלל של חטאת is a jar containing red-heifer ashes. Bartenura on Mishnah Eduyot 7:5 explicitly defines it as an earthenware vessel containing ashes and explains that the ashes become impure even though the vessel is not defiled from its outside. Hadar, Chadid and Tadir remain variant place-names.
